title: Cellular gateway firmware versions MG 4.1.2 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new stable cellularGateway firmware is now available on Tue, 12 Aug 2025

Executive summary: This is a small maintenance release for MG 4.1. It resolves an MTU issue on MG21 appliances and expands the built-in APN list.
What's new: Updated the list of built-in APNs for the Telus provider to include “m2m.telus.iot”.
Updated the list of built-in APNs for the Bell provider to include “mnet.bell.ca.ioe”. (MG-5215)
Other: The product complies with EN 18031-1:2024 and EN 18031-2: 2024
